# AI Gateway v0.3.1

The per-user OAuth profile now keeps the external UI model registry stable when
users alternate or run concurrent chats with different model grants.

## Changes

- Use an explicit operator-owned connection catalog and individual OpenWebUI
  model read ACLs instead of replacing a shared registry with each user's model list.
- Keep System OAuth for every inference request. Gateway independently enforces
  current directory policy; a stale UI ACL cannot authorize a hidden model.
- Require interleaved and parallel chat regressions for two users, both model-list
  endpoints, JSON/SSE, refresh billing and missing-session denial.
- Verify that a UI-only operator without a provisioned Gateway principal cannot
  acquire Gateway inference access.

## Configuration

Follow docs/identity-keycloak-openwebui.md for the pinned Keycloak 26.3.3 and
OpenWebUI 0.11.4 profile. Configure explicit model IDs and user/group read grants;
shared base caching is valid only for this static approved catalog. Never cache
a user-dependent Gateway model response globally. Keep model access enforcement
in the UI enabled and use explicitly assigned tools or disable builtin tools.

Gateway/Auth runtime behavior and the additive migration from v0.3.0 are unchanged.
Working IdP trust, secrets, UI ACLs and directory bindings are configured by the
operator, not enabled automatically by installing this patch. Expanded admin
browser sessions and full external provider/RAG workflows remain separate work.
